name: Lycopodium Powder
use_case: Chladni circular plates, fine-detail nodal mapping
notes_on_hydrophobia: Floats on water; useful for water-surface Cymascope work to trace antinodes (opposite of sand on plates).

behavior.migration_on_plate: nodes (same as sand, but finer resolution)
behavior.migration_on_water_surface: antinodes (floats at crests due to hydrophobia)
behavior.pattern_clarity: excellent above 500 Hz where sand becomes too coarse

safety: Combustible dust; avoid open flame. Respiratory irritant; use in ventilated area.
